scenicChapters.title: Peru Coastal Panamericana South
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Peru Coastal Panamericana South, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-ancient-reduction-of-santiago-apo.story: A 210 km round trip from Lima - roughly 3 h 37 in the saddle. The highest point is about 3,100 m.

scenicChapters.title: Schreckensee → Ödenahlen
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
